mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving S&P 500 forward returns negatively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a benign monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rise in real GDP (GDPC1) and a drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% each within a quarter indicates a shift in consumer spending patterns, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors reassess economic growth prospects.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% and RSAFS decreases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1 million units indicates strong demand in the real estate sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1 million units.
